note: Which wheel-alignment adjustments each real car has, for the tuning menu (FOsdsTuning::ReadAdjustable). Front toe is always adjustable (the tie rods) and is not listed. A car missing here gets front toe only. Sources: the makers' alignment specifications and service manuals as summarised by alignment shops; entries marked estimate were not checked against a manual.

nb1999.source: NB Miata: eccentric bolts on all four lower arms set camber, caster and rear toe

mustang65.source: upper control arm shims set camber and caster; leaf-sprung live rear axle has none

camaro87.source: estimate: strut-to-knuckle camber; live rear axle

mini15s.source: estimate: F56 front struts fixed; rear multi-link eccentrics

model3.source: Tesla alignment specification: front camber and caster not adjustable; rear camber and toe are

grandcherokee13.source: estimate: WK2 cam bolts front and rear

f150raptor18.source: estimate: front cam bolts; live rear axle

meridian_z.source: OSDS's own sports car: a track car's full adjustment
